text: Microsoft certification exams run around two hours for fifty to sixty questions — under two minutes a question on average. That average matters more than any single question.
Short, factual questions should take well under a minute. Long scenario questions get the extra time you banked. After the first fifteen to twenty questions, do a quick pace check.
If a question isn't resolving after a genuine attempt, flag it and move on. Some exam formats include a case-study section you can't revisit once you leave it — budget that section specifically.
Apply the trap patterns before hunting for the right answer directly. Eliminating two wrong options turns a four-way guess into a coin flip.
State your time budget and flag threshold in advance, not mid-exam. Next up: putting all of this together in a full-length mock exam.
